title: Vague verb without an operation list
whyThisCase: Classic Phase 4/7 example. 'Manage users' does not say which operations are allowed. After a successful detect, resolving Create/Edit/Deactivate is what clears the quality-score vague-verb flag. The other two sentences are specific so the plant is obvious when you read the output.

mustExtract.note: The vague sentence must become a requirement unit, not get dropped as commentary.

ambiguities.note: Should flag that permitted operations (create, edit, deactivate, delete, …) are undefined.
